today.title: {weekday}, {month} {day}
today.emptyWhy: Today reads 0 because nothing has uploaded yet: the PC uploads every hour. If it was on, leave ActivityWatch open and wait for the next upload.
today.emptyPastWhy: That day reads 0 because no upload arrived: the PC was off or ActivityWatch was closed. There is nothing to fix; for the days ahead, leave ActivityWatch open.
today.never: No upload has arrived yet. Install ActivityWatch + TimeLog on your PC with the installer on «Keys» and paste a key: it uploads by itself every hour.
today.byClassLabel: The day split by class of app

week.title: {from} to {to}
week.claudeNever: No Claude time has arrived yet. See «Today» for how to connect it.
week.heatmap: Each app's time, day by day

keys.title: Keys
keys.intro: A key lets your PC's script upload the day's summary and lets Claude read it. It is shown only once.
keys.install: On Windows, install ActivityWatch + TimeLog and paste the key in its icon, next to the clock: «TimeLog: paste key…». It uploads by itself every hour.
keys.name: Key name
keys.nameInvalid: Give it a name of up to 60 characters.
keys.signedOut: Your session expired. Sign in again.
keys.revokeFailed: The key could not be revoked. Reload and try again.
keys.shown: Copy it now: it is not shown again.
keys.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
keys.command: Without the installer, on the PC with ActivityWatch open:
keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke «{name}»? It stops uploading and reading.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: TimeLog keeps a summary of how long your computer spends in each app, day by day. For now, access is by invitation. We email you a link to sign in.
signIn.sent: Check your email: the link brings you back here.
signIn.emailInvalid: That email does not look right.
signIn.notInvited: That email is not invited to TimeLog.
signIn.sendFailed: The link could not be sent. Try again.
signIn.rateLimited: You have asked for several links. Wait a few minutes.
signIn.linkInvalid: The link did not work or has expired. Ask for another.

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.text: The day you are looking for does not exist or has not arrived yet.

claude.title: Claude
claude.never: No Claude Code time has arrived yet. It is read from its sessions folder on your PC; if you use it in WSL, point to that folder in aw-timelog.toml (claude_dir) and wait for the next upload.
claude.overlap: The three add up as they are: if you used two at once, both count.

internet.title: Internet
internet.never: No sites have arrived yet. Install ActivityWatch's browser extension and they will show here after the next upload.
internet.privacy: Only you see this. Sites and apps on your exclusion list (banks and password managers, by default) never leave your PC.

export.title: Export
export.intro: A CSV with a row per day: time on the computer, Claude Code, claude.ai, Claude in total and the most used app, all in seconds. Claude reads the same rows with the get_daily tool.
export.badRange: That range did not work: «From» is on or before «To», up to 366 days.
